name: CatalystDesk Market Regime
description: Inspect descriptive market regime, liquidity, and cross-frame statistics for curated tickers.

auth.paid_tools: Prepaid bearer sessions and x402 are supported by the gateway when the client can supply payment headers.

compliance_notes: Use get_polygon_data_status to check your own Polygon / Massive tier. Bind a key at /v1/session/console or use the stdio --save-polygon-key-stdin command.
Requests without a usable Polygon key get 15-minute delayed synthetic fallback at zero charge. See /go/polygon for subscription plans.
Descriptive market regime analytics only. No investment advice, trade recommendations, or order placement.
Tool responses set executable to false and redistribution_allowed to false.
Paid analytics use your real-time or 15-minute delayed Polygon / Massive key. Without a usable key, the gateway returns clearly labeled synthetic context at zero charge.
